items.text: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) ruled out remainder of Week 9 vs CAR after high-low hit; DEN has bye Week 10 so targets return Week 11.
items.why: Mandatory protocol after violent hit; second documented concussion.
items.implication: Bye cushions recovery; clear protocol for Week 11 vs LV.
items.opportunity: Pat Bryant target share jumps to ~23% without Waddle

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) ruled out remainder of Week 9 vs GB after late 3rd-quarter exit; MRI pending, next game vs DET Week 10.
items.why: Left on reception, medical tent then locker room; thin NE backfield with Henderson already out.
items.implication: Corey Kiner/Lan Larison lead if both out Week 10; high-scoring DET matchup.
items.opportunity: Handcuff elevation and goal-line share for backups

items.text: Puka Nacua suffered a knee injury on the Rams' final offensive snap vs Washington and will undergo MRI Monday; team believes ACL is intact.
items.why: Late-game low hit on same knee as prior PCL; early optimism no ACL tear but imaging needed.
items.implication: Major volume risk for Rams offense already missing Adams; monitor for Week 10 availability.
items.opportunity: If out, elevated TE/WR2 targets and Kyren work

items.text: Patrick Mahomes checked out OK after injuring throwing elbow Sunday; returned to game.
items.implication: No expected miss; Worthy hamstring separate concern.

items.text: In Breece Hall return from quad, 19 opportunities vs Braelon Allen 10; Allen outsnapped Hall 37-27.
items.why: Opportunity share favors Hall despite snap deficit on return.
items.implication: Hall lead back but timeshare continues; monitor snaps ROS.
items.opportunity: 19 opp confirms workhorse potential if snaps rise

items.text: DEN: Jonah Coleman 58 snaps / JK Dobbins 11 (other RBs 0); last two weeks Coleman 37 opp vs Dobbins 12.
items.implication: Dobbins buried; Coleman clear lead if healthy.

items.text: Justin Herbert will undergo testing on left middle finger (non-throwing hand); Harbaugh said it could be a fracture. Herbert expects to play Week 10 vs BAL.
items.why: Injured stiff-arming on sack in 4th of blowout loss; same finger previously fractured.
items.implication: Non-throwing hand lowers miss risk; backup Uiagalelei available if needed.

items.text: Josh Jacobs (hand) among Sunday injuries watched; left early, possible fractured finger per later reports.
items.why: Exited early; team tried to get him back.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 10; Lloyd/Johnson if miss.

items.text: George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) OUT vs IND; Ryan Flournoy the obvious pivot and solid WR2 profile today.
items.why: Multiple sources confirm out; Flournoy inherits.

items.text: SEA: Zach Charbonnet out-snapped Jadarian Price 37-24 and out-routed 13-9; Holani 2 snaps.
items.why: Clear lead for Charbonnet in snaps/routes post any prior uncertainty.
items.implication: Price handcuff/committee only; Charbonnet preferred ROS.

items.text: LV trailing script: Ashton Jeanty 32 snaps vs Mike Washington 17; Jeanty 24-6 routes, carries 6-6.
items.why: Clear snap/route lead even in pass-heavy script.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (back) and Justin Herbert (undisclosed) among key injuries watched post-Sunday.
items.why: Listed in ETR Sunday injury watch with Herbert.
items.implication: Chargers WR depth thin; monitor practice.

items.text: Xavier Worthy (hamstring) injured alongside Mahomes elbow (returned); watching status.
items.why: In-game hamstring issue noted by ETR.
items.implication: KC WR depth; Rice/others if miss.

items.text: Tank Dell looking fully healthy with 55% routes, 9 targets, 105 yards in return ramp; easy guy to root for and priority waiver upside.
items.why: Clear utilization jump and production after injury absences.
items.implication: WR starter upside ROS; priority add if available.
